newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU vets GE/United Technologies engine deal.
newsitem.headline: EU vets GE/United Technologies engine deal.

text.p: The European Commission said on Friday it was reviewing a joint venture between General Electric Co's aircraft engines unit and the Pratt & Whitney division of United Technologies Corporation.

P&W and General Electric Aircraft Engines have formed a joint venture through which they will jointly design, develop, produce, market, sell and support a new aircraft engine for larger versions of 747-400 planes being developed by Boeing Co, the Commission said in a statement.
It said the deal was submitted for clearance on September 26 under European Union rules which ban anti-competitive behaviour and abuse of dominant position.
Although both companies are based in the United States they do business in the 15-nation Union.
There is no strict deadline to rule on the deal, but the Commission tries to inform companies involved in so-called cooperative joint ventures of its findings within two months of notification.
It invited interested parties to comment within 10 days. -- Brussels newsroom 322 2876841
